# Mannan Shukla

> Personal site of Mannan Shukla: inference platform engineering, cloud native software engineering, and building tools for agents. Founder of spawnpoint, the place where your team's AI lives.

## Projects

- [spawnpoint](https://getspawnpoint.com/): The place where your team's AI lives. A coding agent builds a tool, an MCP server, or an app that uses AI, deploys it through spawnpoint's MCP server, and gets back a private link to share with one person or a whole company.
- [spawnpoint for agents](https://getspawnpoint.com/llms.txt): spawnpoint's agent-readable index: connecting an agent, what you can deploy, the MCP tools, sharing, and plans.
